'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Steve Skilton LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Skilton]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates]]
* '''Username:''' stevetotheizzo
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
